hub.heading: Programs
hub.intro: ACTS programs give residents of all ages practical skills, trusted information, and opportunities to lead.

items.title: Community Garden + Food Resources
items.description: Gardening classes, hands-on learning, food literacy, and environmental education, plus a directory of food and community resources.

items.title: 4-H, STEAM + Robotics
items.description: Real-world learning that builds creative problem-solvers, innovators, critical thinkers, and future leaders.

items.title: Neighborhood Environmental Ambassadors
items.description: Building resident leadership for healthier, more resilient neighborhoods.

garden.heading: Community Garden
garden.body: The ACTS community garden is a place for gardening classes, hands-on learning, food literacy, and environmental education.

classes.heading: Gardening Classes
classes.body: Gardening classes offer practical opportunities to learn how to grow food, practice environmental stewardship, and build food literacy.

resources.heading: Food Resources
resources.intro: A directory of food and community resources for residents. Entries will be added as ACTS verifies providers.

steam.heading: STEAM + Robotics
steam.body: ACTS STEAM and robotics programming offers real-world learning that builds creative problem-solvers, innovators, critical thinkers, and future leaders. Students explore science, technology, engineering, art, and math by designing, building, and solving problems together.

ambassadors.heading: NEIGHBORHOOD ENVIRONMENTAL AMBASSADORS
ambassadors.subhead: BUILDING RESIDENT LEADERSHIP FOR HEALTHIER, MORE RESILIENT NEIGHBORHOODS.
ambassadors.body: The Neighborhood Environmental Ambassadors program equips residents with the knowledge, skills, communication tools, civic literacy, and confidence to understand environmental issues and participate in community action.

activities.label: Gardening Classes
activities.description: Practical, hands-on opportunities to grow food, practice environmental stewardship, and build food literacy.

activities.label: Community Data Summaries
activities.description: ACTS translates environmental and air-monitoring data into accessible summaries residents can use and share.

activities.label: Ambassador Programs
activities.description: Training in leadership, communication, civic literacy, and advocacy.

activities.label: Community Education
activities.description: Learning opportunities that help neighbors understand environmental issues and how to respond.

ambassadors.closing: RESIDENTS SHOULD NOT JUST BE INFORMED. THEY SHOULD BE EQUIPPED TO ADVOCATE.
